'''Grelius''' is an [[NPC]] and guard to {{NPCSprite|Queen Nyx}}, who primarily guards the {{zone|Throne Room}} with {{NPCSprite|Krevius}}. They also briefly appear in other places on the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}, twice during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] and once at the end of both [[Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questlines]].

== Quests ==
'''Grelius''' prevents the player from entering the {{Zone|Throne Room}} until you present a {{Item|Letter of Recommendation}} during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]]. 

Later in this questline, they appear with {{NPCSprite|Krevius}} and {{NPCSprite|Captain Ahone}} in the {{Zone|Burning Desert}} when you call Captain Ahone about the {{NPCSprite|Apprentice (Crimson Isle);Apprentice}}. They also appear with the two in the {{Zone|Mage Council}} when discussing stolen {{Item|Sulphur}}.

At the end of both [[Faction]] quests, they appear in the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}} with {{NPCSprite|Krevius}}, {{NPCSprite|Captain Ahone}}, {{NPCSprite|Elle}}, {{NPCSprite|Ugo}}, and two {{NPCSprite|Piglin Guard;Piglin Guards}}.
